IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p413/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p413/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p413/r5.claim: God's promise to make the Prophet's difficulties easy continues the earlier promise, “We shall ease you toward ease.”
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p413/r5.anchor: وعد الله تعالى نبيئه صلى الله عليه وسلم بأن الله جعل الأمور العسرة عليه يسرة له

BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r3.claim: God makes the Prophet's path easy in every religious matter, enabling reception of revelation, knowledge and teaching of the law, and guidance of others.
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r3.anchor: {ونيسرك لليسرى} عطف على نقرئك واليسرى فعلى من اليسر

BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r4.claim: The wording makes the Prophet himself easy for the path, signaling such strong mastery and ability that ease becomes a settled trait.
BURSEVI:v10p315#2/r4.anchor: للإيذان بقوة تمكينه عليه السلام من اليسرى والتصرف فيها بحيث صار ذلك ملكة رسخة له

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the easier way as goodness.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3417/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : ونيسرك لليسرى قال : للخير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r1.claim: The feminine easiest has an omitted feminine noun, likely the religious law, since the Prophet's defining role as messenger is to convey a sharia.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r1.anchor: وسياق الكلام الذي قبله يهدي إلى أن يكون الموصوف المقدر معنى الشريعة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r2.claim: On the surface reading, making the Prophet easy for the easiest is a metaphor for preparing and enabling him to manage the easy religious path and its good outcomes.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r2.anchor: فالتيسير مستعار للتهيئة والتسخير ، أي قوة تمكينه صلى الله عليه وسلم من اليسرى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r3.claim: The preparation includes preserving the Quran, easing the law he conveys, and granting good in this world and the next; the lām marks purpose or readiness to receive it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r3.anchor: من تيسير حفظ القرآن لك وتيسير الشريعة التي أرسلت بها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r4.claim: An alternative reads the construction as inversion: God makes the easiest easy for the Prophet, keeping the verb in its literal sense.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن يجعل الكلام جاريا على خلاف مقتضى الظاهر بسلوك أسلوب القلب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r5.claim: Calling it the easiest implies that its ease is already established; the remaining need is protection from obstacles, so the passage describes both easy duties and the Prophet's capacity to perform them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p282/r5.anchor: فاشتمل الكلام على تيسيرين : تيسير ما كلف به النبي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90/r1.claim: God makes the Prophet's work of goodness easy for him.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p90/r1.anchor: ونيسرك لليسرى أي نسهل عليك عمل الخير

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r1.claim: Nuyassiruka coordinates with the promise of recitation, while the statement that God knows the loud and hidden is parenthetical; it means easing the Prophet toward memorizing revelation.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r1.anchor: معطوف على { سنقرئك } وقوله : { إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى } اعتراض

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r2.claim: Other interpretations are guidance to the easy, tolerant law or to the deeds leading to Paradise.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p741/r2.anchor: وقيل للشريعة السمحة التي هي أيسر الشرائع وأسهلها مأخذا

MUQATIL:87:8-13/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:87:8-13/r1.claim: God makes the Prophet's task easier by replacing a verse with one easier than it.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r1.claim: This clause is coordinated with “We shall make you recite”; the preceding clause is an aside, and the meaning is that God will enable the easier way of preserving revelation.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r1.anchor: معطوف على سنقرئك وقوله انه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى اعتراض ومعناه ونوفقك للطريقة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r2.claim: Other interpretations take the easier way as the lenient revealed law or as enabling the Prophet to perform the deeds of Paradise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p332#8/r2.anchor: وقيل للشريعة السمحة التى هى أيسر الشرائع أو توفقك لعمل الجنة

QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r6.claim: The clause “We will ease you” coordinates with “We will make you recite,” while “He knows the manifest and hidden” is parenthetical.

QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r7.claim: Al-yusrā means the easy way, namely doing good; Ibn ʿAbbas says God will enable the Prophet to do good.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r7.anchor: ومعنى { لليسرى } أي للطريقة اليسرى وهي عمل الخير. قال ابن عباس: نيسرك لأن تعمل خيرا.

QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r8.speaker: ابن مسعود والضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r8.claim: Ibn Masʿud glosses al-yusrā as Paradise; al-Dahhak says it is the easy, tolerant hanif law, or that revelation will be made easy to memorize and practice.
QURTUBI-FULL:87:7-8/r8.anchor: ابن مسعود: «لليسرى» أي للجنة. وقيل: نوفقك للشريعة اليسرى وهي الحنيفية السمحة السهلة قال معناه الضحاك.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.claim: Al-Aʿla is Meccan and has nineteen verses; the Prophet loved it, recited it at Eid and Friday prayers with al-Ghashiya, sometimes on the same day.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r1.anchor: سورة الأعلى مكية وآياتها تسع عشرة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.claim: The surah turns the entire cosmos into a sanctuary reverberating with praise and offers the Prophet good news of divine preservation and ease in his mission and affairs.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r3.anchor: وحق لرسول الله [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] أن يحب هذه السورة وهي تحيل له الكون كله معبدا

QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.claim: Its foundations are God's oneness as creator, divine revelation, and afterlife recompense, rooted in earlier scriptures; it also portrays the easy nature of the message, messenger, and community.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:1/r4.anchor: وهي تتضمن الثابت من قواعد التصور الإيماني

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r1.claim: “We ease you toward ease” promises ease to the Prophet and his community and defines the religion, its mission, and its place in existence.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r1.anchor: بشرى لشخص الرسول [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] وبشرى لأمته من ورائه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r2.claim: God's easing links the Prophet, religion, and cosmos: existence itself emerges easily, moves easily, and proceeds easily toward its goal.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r2.anchor: الوجود الخارج من يد القدرة في يسر

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r3.claim: The person God eases moves gently with the ordered universe and events; ease shapes his speech, steps, work, thought, and dealings with himself and others.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r3.anchor: اليسر في يده . واليسر في لسانه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r4.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r4.speaker: الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r4.claim: Aisha reports that when given two choices, the Prophet selected the easier; when at home, he was the gentlest of people, smiling and laughing.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r4.anchor: ما خير بين أمرين إلا اختار أيسرهما كما روت عنه عائشة - رضي الله عنها -

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r5.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r5.speaker: ابن قيم الجوزية
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r5.claim: Ibn al-Qayyim describes the Prophet's clothing as varied and unforced, chosen according to what was available and fitting; sometimes he let a turban's tail hang and sometimes not.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r5.anchor: شمس الدين أبي عبد الله محمد بن قيم الجوزية

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r6.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r6.speaker: ابن قيم الجوزية
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r6.claim: Ibn al-Qayyim says the Prophet ate available pleasant food without demanding what was absent, never criticized food, and left disliked food without declaring it forbidden; he ate a lizard while companions watched.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r6.anchor: لا يرد موجودا ولا يتكلف مفقودا

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r7.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r7.speaker: ابن قيم الجوزية
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r7.claim: Ibn al-Qayyim recounts the Prophet sleeping on varied surfaces, from a bed, mat, or ground to a couch or black cloth.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r7.anchor: كان ينام على فراشه تارة وعلى النطع تارة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r8.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r8.claim: The Prophet teaches that religion is easy and that whoever makes it onerous will be overcome by it; al-Bukhari is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r8.anchor: إن هذا الدين يسر ، ولن يشاد الدين أحد إلا غلبه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r9.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r9.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r9.claim: The Prophet warns against imposing strictness, saying that earlier people imposed it on themselves and it was imposed on them; Abu Dawud is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r9.anchor: لا تشددوا على أنفسكم فيشدد عليكم فإن قوما شددوا على أنفسهم

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r10.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r10.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r10.claim: The Prophet compares an overburdened traveler to one who neither crosses the land nor preserves his mount; al-Bukhari is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r10.anchor: إن المنبت لا أرضا قطع ولا ظهرا أبقى

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r11.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r11.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r11.claim: The Prophet instructs people to make matters easy rather than difficult; both Sahih collections are cited.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r12.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r12.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r12.claim: The Prophet asks God's mercy for a person who is gracious when selling, buying, and collecting payment; al-Bukhari is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r12.anchor: رحم الله رجلا سمحا إذا باع وإذا اشترى وإذا اقتضى

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r13.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r13.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r13.claim: The Prophet describes a believer as gentle and easygoing; al-Bayhaqi is cited.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r14.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r14.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r14.claim: The Prophet says that a believer forms relationships and is welcomed by others; al-Daraqutni is cited.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r15.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r15.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r15.claim: The Prophet says God most hates a contentious, quarrelsome person; both Sahih collections are cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r15.anchor: إن أبغض الرجال إلى الله الألد الخصم

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r16.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r16.speaker: سعيد بن المسيب
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r16.claim: Saʿid ibn al-Musayyib recounts from his father that the Prophet changed his name from Hazn (hardness) to Sahl (ease); his father refused, and Saʿid said hardness remained among them; al-Bukhari is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r16.anchor: عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبيه - رضي الله عنه - أنه جاء للنبي

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r17.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r17.speaker: ابن عمر
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r17.claim: Ibn Umar reports that the Prophet changed the name ʿAsiya to Jamila; Muslim is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r17.anchor: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما - أن رسول الله [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] غير اسم عاصية وسماها جميلة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r18.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r18.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r18.claim: The Prophet says that greeting one's brother with a cheerful face is an act of kindness; al-Tirmidhi is cited.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r18.anchor: إن من المعروف أن تلقى أخاك بوجه طلق

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r19.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r19.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r19.claim: The Prophet's fine sensibility noticed harshness even in names and faces and turned toward gentleness, reflecting his God-given nature and ease-oriented formation.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r19.anchor: فهو الحس المرهف الذي يلمح الوعورة والشدة حتى في الأسماء والملامح فينفر منها

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r20.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r20.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r20.claim: When a Bedouin insulted him after receiving a gift, the Prophet stopped his companions from retaliating, privately gave the man more, and arranged public reconciliation so their resentment would pass.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r20.anchor: جاءه أعرابي يوما يطلب منه شيئا فأعطاه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r21.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r21.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r21.claim: The Prophet explains that he handled the man like an owner calmly retrieving a frightened runaway camel, and warns that killing the Bedouin would have sent him to Hell.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r21.anchor: إن مثلي ومثل هذا الأعرابي كمثل رجل كانت له ناقة شردت عليه

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r22.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r22.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r22.claim: Gentle, simple, effective handling of alienated people exemplifies how the Prophet's life and mission fulfilled God's promise to ease him.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r22.anchor: فهكذا كان أخذه [ صلى الله عليه وسلم ] للنفوس الشاردة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r23.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r23.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r23.claim: The Prophet's ease made the great trust of the message a beloved, joyful practice rather than a crushing burden.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r23.anchor: حيث تتحول الرسالة بهذا التيسير من عبء مثقل

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r24.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r24.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r24.claim: The Qur'an calls the Prophet a mercy to the worlds; 7:157 describes him as known in Torah and Gospel, commanding good, forbidding wrong, permitting wholesome things, prohibiting foul things, and lifting burdens and shackles.

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r25.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r25.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r25.claim: The message itself is easy: 54:17 makes the Qur'an easy to remember; 22:78 and 5:6 reject hardship; 2:286 limits duty to capacity; even commanded duties must be done as far as one can.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r25.anchor: ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر فهل من مدكر

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r26.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r26.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r26.claim: The Prophet says to do what one can of a command, avoid what is prohibited, and recognizes necessity as an exception to prohibitions; the passage gives no collection or grading.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r26.anchor: إذا أمرتكم بأمر فأتوا منه ما استطعتم

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r27.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r27.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r27.claim: The creed is simple and obligations flow from it coherently; people fulfill them within their capacity, and necessities may exempt them from prohibited things.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r27.anchor: والتكاليف بعد ذلك كلها تنبثق من هذه العقيدة في تناسق مطلق لا عوج فيه ولا انحراف

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r28.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r28.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r28.claim: The easy-going Prophet and easy message produced a balanced, merciful community whose nature aligns with the easy nature of the universe.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r28.anchor: فهي الأمة الوسط ، وهي الأمة المرحومة الحاملة للرحمة

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r29.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r29.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r29.claim: The cosmos moves without collision or disorder: celestial bodies, living beings, and events all proceed toward their ends in measured harmony, like instruments joining one melody.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r29.anchor: ملايين الملايين من الأجرام تسبح في فضاء الله

QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r30.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r30.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r30.claim: The universe, message, Prophet, and Muslim community are in complete accord as creations of the one God.
QUTB-ZILAL:87:8/r30.anchor: إنه التوافق المطلق بين طبيعة الوجود

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r1.claim: Al-yusrā denotes good deeds that lead to ease.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r1.anchor: اليسرى هي أعمال الخير التي تؤدي إلى اليسر

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r2.claim: The clause coordinates with 87:6, with the knowledge clause parenthetical; God enables the easiest path, especially memorizing the Qur’an.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r2.anchor: ونوفقك للطريقة التي هي أسهل وأيسر ، يعني في حفظ القرآن

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r3.claim: Al-yusrā means Paradise, and God enables the Prophet to do the deeds that lead to it.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r3.anchor: قال ابن مسعود : اليسرى الجنة ، والمعنى نيسرك للعمل المؤدى إليها

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r4.claim: Another interpretation is that God makes revelation easy for the Prophet to memorize, understand, and act upon.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r4.anchor: نهون عليك الوحي حتى تحفظه وتعلمه وتعمل به

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r5.claim: Another interpretation is that God guides the Prophet to the easy, tolerant hanifī law.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r5.anchor: نوفقك للشريعة وهي الحنيفية السهلة السمحة

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r6.claim: The wording makes the agent enabled for an act: a merely possible act occurs only when doing outweighs refraining, and that preponderance is facilitation; the Prophet’s hadith uses the same wording.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r6.anchor: اعملوا فكل ميسر لما خلق له ) وفيه لطيفة علمية

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r7.claim: The majestic plural magnifies the gift by magnifying its giver, as in other divine first-person plurals.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r7.anchor: إنما قال : { ونيسرك لليسرى } بنون التعظيم لتكون عظمة المعطى دالة على عظمة العطاء

RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r8.claim: God opened exceptional paths of ease for Muhammad: an orphan raised among an ignorant people became a model in words and deeds for all creation.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130/r8.anchor: فتح عليه من أبواب التيسير والستهيل ما لم يفتحه على أحد غيره

RAZI-FULL:v31p130#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p130#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p130#2/r1.claim: God gave Muhammad unmatched facilitation and made him, despite his orphaned upbringing among an ignorant people, a universal exemplar.
RAZI-FULL:v31p130#2/r1.anchor: كان صبيا لا أب له ولا أم له نشأ في قوم جهال ، ثم إنه تعالى جعله في أفعاله وأقواله قدوة للعالمين

SAMIN-DURR:87:8/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:87:8/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:87:8/r1.claim: Wa-nuyassiruka coordinates with sanaqriʾuka and remains under its promise of easing; the intervening clause is parenthetical.
SAMIN-DURR:87:8/r1.anchor: عطف على " سنقرئك " فهو داخل في حيز التنفيس، وما بينهما من الجملة اعتراض.

STUDYQURAN:87:8/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r1.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r1.claim: One interpretation is that God eases the way by making revealed law uncomplicated.
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r1.anchor: Some understand this verse as an allusion to the uncomplicated nature of the revealed law

STUDYQURAN:87:8/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r2.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r2.claim: In context of the preceding verses, God makes it easy for the Prophet to memorize the Quran.
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r2.anchor: in light of vv. 6–7, this verse indicates that God will make it easy for the Prophet to memorize the Quran

STUDYQURAN:87:8/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r3.speaker: others
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r3.claim: Another interpretation is that God eases believers' way into Paradise.
STUDYQURAN:87:8/r3.anchor: Others interpret the verse as a reference to God’s easing the way for believers to enter Paradise

TAB:87:8/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:8/r1.speaker: author
TAB:87:8/r1.claim: God makes Muhammad's way easy for good works; al-yusrā is the feminine form of yusr, ease.
TAB:87:8/r1.anchor: ونسْهلك يا محمد لعمل الخير ،   وهو اليُسرَى واليُسرَى :  هو الفُعلى من اليسر .

TAB-FULL:v24p316#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p316#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p316#2/r1.claim: God makes Muhammad’s path to good easy; al-yusrā is the feminine form built from ease.
TAB-FULL:v24p316#2/r1.anchor: يقول تعالى ذكره: ونسهلك يا محمد لعمل الخير، وهو اليسرى؛ واليسرى: هو الفعلى من اليسر

TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r6.claim: The easier path is the Hanif religion; God facilitates revelation so the Prophet memorizes, practices, and does not oppose it.
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r6.anchor: نوفقك للشريعة اليسرى وهي الحنيفية ونهون عليك الوحي ونسهله حتى تحفظه ولا تنساه

TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r7.speaker: أبو مسلم
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r7.claim: Abū Muslim prefers that God supplies support and aid to steady the Prophet, easing the hard work of preaching and patience; this connects to the preceding promise of recitation.
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r7.anchor: نسهل لك من الألطاف والتأييد ما يثبتك على أمرك

TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r8.speaker: الجبائي
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r8.claim: Al-Jubbāʾī says al-yusrā refers to Paradise, the greatest ease, whose entry God makes easy for the Prophet.
TABRISI:87:7-9#2/r8.anchor: إن اليسرى عبارة عن الجنة فهي اليسرى الكبرى أي نيسر لك دخول الجنة عن الجبائي

ASAD-NOTES:87:6#n6/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:87:6#n6/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:87:6#n6/r1.claim: The easy way means ease of mind and peace of spirit.
ASAD-NOTES:87:6#n6/r1.anchor: towards an ease of the mind and peace of the spirit

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r3.speaker: عطاء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r3.claim: God makes all Muhammad’s affairs easy.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r3.anchor: قال عطاء: نيسرك يا محمد في جميع أمورك لليسرى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r4.speaker: مقاتل، ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r4.claim: God makes the work of Paradise or good deeds easy for Muhammad.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r4.anchor: وقال مقاتل: نهون عليك عمل الجنة (¬5)، وهو معنى قول ابن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r5.claim: “The easier way” means Paradise, so the verse means God makes the deeds leading there easy.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r5.anchor: وروي عن ابن مسعود أنه قال: اليسرى الجنة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p440/r6.claim: Two further interpretations are easing revelation, its memorization and practice, or granting success in the easy, tolerant Hanif law.

WAHIDI-QT:87:8/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:87:8/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:87:8/r1.claim: God makes the tolerant, upright religion easy for the Prophet.
WAHIDI-QT:87:8/r1.anchor: أي نهون عليك الشريعة اليسرى وهي الحنيفية السمحة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r4.claim: God makes the easy religion of the tolerant, upright monotheistic way easy for the Prophet.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:87:7-16/r4.anchor: أي: نهون عليك الشريعة اليسرى، وهي الحنيفية السمحة.

ELMALILI:87:7-13/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r4.claim: God will make the Prophet successful in the easiest path or goal and turn this success into an easy, firmly rooted disposition.
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r4.anchor: Ve seni yüsrâya müyesser, yani muvaffak kılacağız. Her hususta en kolay yola veya gayeye erdireceğiz.

ELMALILI:87:7-13/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r5.claim: This facilitation covers every religious domain: knowledge, teaching, practice, guidance, and finding guidance; the Prophet and his religion reach the hardest ends with ease.
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r5.anchor: dinin her bâbında: ilimde, tâlimde, amelde, hidâyet ve ihtidâda

ELMALILI:87:7-13/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r6.claim: The promise includes receiving outward and inward revelation and the ease of a generous, unburdensome law that perfects the self and others.
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r6.anchor: zâhir ve bâtından vahiy telakkīsini ve ondaki semâhatli ve harecsiz şeriat ve ahkâmın gerek tekmîl-i nefse ve gerek tekmîl-i gayra müte‘allik

ELMALILI:87:7-13/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r7.claim: Tawhid, sincerity, true knowledge, and rightly ordered effort are foundations of ease, whose foremost source is God's enabling grace.
ELMALILI:87:7-13/r7.anchor: Îmân-ı tevhid, ihlâs, ilm-i hak, usûlüyle sa‘y ü amel her kolaylığın başı

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r1.claim: The phrase means making the addressee able to reach what is easy; Q 92 applies it to the blessed generally and contrasts it with easing the damned toward hardship.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r1.anchor: Dieselbe Wendung erscheint auch in Q 92, wird dort allerdings auf den Seligen im Allgemeinen und nicht nur auf den Verkünder angewandt

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r2.claim: The easy/hard contrast also appears in Q 94:5–6 as reassurance addressed to the Prophet, like this passage.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:8:anmerkung/r2.anchor: Das Gegensatzpaar ʿusr / yusr erscheint auch in Q 94:5.6

QIRAAT-ER:87:8:4#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:87:8:4#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:87:8:4#1/r1.claim: The ten-reading variant has a fuller vowel texture in yusurā while preserving its root and phrase function.
QIRAAT-ER:87:8:4#1/r1.anchor: fuller vowel texture in yusurā; it preserves the same root and phrase function

ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r1.claim: The promise to ease the Prophet is coordinated with “We shall make you recite,” and the intervening verse is parenthetical; addressing the Prophet as the one eased suggests a firmly established capacity for it.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r1.anchor: ونيسرك لليسرى عطف على سنقرئك كما ينبيء عنه الألتفات إلى الحكاية

ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r2.claim: The preferred broad sense is sustained divine enabling of the easiest way in every part of religion—knowledge, teaching, guidance, and being guided—including revelation, law, and perfecting the Prophet and others.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r2.anchor: أي نوفقك توفيقا مستمرا للطريقة اليسرى في كل باب من أبواب الدين علما وتعليقا واهتداء وهداية

ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r3.claim: Other views identify “the easiest way” as an easier way to retain revelation, the easy Hanif law, or good worldly and afterlife outcomes such as victory, status, and Paradise; adding religion broadens the last view.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p107/r3.anchor: وقيل المراد باليسرى الطريقة التي هي أيسر وأسهل في حفظ الوحي وقيل هي الشريعة الحنيفية السهلة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r1.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r1.claim: Muqatil says God will make the Prophet’s work easy for Paradise; Ibn Abbas’s gloss similarly says he will be enabled to do good, with ‘the easier way’ meaning good works.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r1.anchor: قال مقاتل: نهون عليك عمل أهل الجنة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r2.claim: Another view takes the phrase to mean that God will grant the Prophet the easy, tolerant monotheistic law.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r2.anchor: وقيل: نوفقك للشريعة اليسرى وهي الحنيفية السمحة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r3.claim: A contextual reading links the promise to revelation: God will ease the Prophet’s recitation, memory, and teaching of what he receives from Gabriel.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p401#2/r3.anchor: ثم وعده فقال: {ونيسرك لليسرى} أي نهون عليك الوحي

BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r1.claim: God prepares the Prophet for the easier way, whether that means preserving revelation or practicing religion, and enables him in it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r1.anchor: ونعدك لطريقة اليسرى في حفظ الوحي، أو التدين وتوفقك لها

BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r2.claim: The wording نيسرك rather than “make it easy for you” suits its coordination with سنقرئك and signals an intervening clause.
BAYDAWI-FULL:87:8/r2.anchor: ولهذه النكتة قال { نيسرك } لا نيسر لك عطف على { سنقرئك }

BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r3.claim: God makes the Prophet prepared, gentle, guided, and at ease in preserving and reflecting on revelation and in all easy ways.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r3.anchor: نجعلك أنت مهيأ مسهلا ملينا موفقا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r4.claim: The wording says God makes the Prophet himself easy because he is naturally disposed to love ease, rather than merely making ease available to him.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r4.anchor: ونيسر لك , لأنه هو مطبوع على حبها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r5.claim: The saying that everyone is facilitated toward what they were created for supports the interpretation of divine facilitation.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p397/r5.anchor: قوله : ( كل ميسر لما خلق له )

ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r1.claim: The verb is coordinated with sanuqriʾuka; the intervening emphatic clause is parenthetical.

ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r2.claim: God guides the Prophet along the easiest way, specifically making revelation easy for him to memorize.
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r2.anchor: أي يوفقك للطريقة التي هي أيسر وأسهل

ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r3.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r3.claim: An alternative takes al-yusrā as the easy, monotheistic religious law.
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r3.anchor: في حفظ الوحي . وقيل : للشريعة الحنيفية السهلة

ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r4.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r4.claim: Another explanation is that God leads him to good worldly and otherworldly outcomes: victory, rank, and elevation in Paradise.
ABUHAYYAN:87:8/r4.anchor: وقيل : يذهب بك إلى الأمور الحسنة في أمر دنياك

ALUSI:87:8/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:8/r1.claim: The promise of easing the Prophet is coordinated with We shall have you recite; the intervening clause is parenthetical.
ALUSI:87:8/r1.anchor: عطف على { سنقرئك } كما ينبئ عنه الالتفات إلى الحكاية وما بينهما اعتراض

ALUSI:87:8/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:8/r2.claim: Addressing the easing to the Prophet himself, rather than to the facilitated task, conveys mastery of the easy way so strong that it becomes a settled disposition.
ALUSI:87:8/r2.anchor: وتعليق التيسير به صلى الله عليه وسلم مع أن الشائع تعليقه بالأمور المسخرة

ALUSI:87:8/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:8/r3.claim: The main explanation is sustained divine success in every religious domain: knowledge and teaching, guidance and guiding others, including receiving revelation and comprehending the lenient law, for the Prophet's perfection and others'.
ALUSI:87:8/r3.anchor: أي نوفقك توفيقاً مستمراً للطريقة اليسرى في كل باب من أبواب الدين علماً وتعليماً

ALUSI:87:8/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:8/r4.claim: One alternative takes al-yusrā to mean the easiest way of preserving revelation.
ALUSI:87:8/r4.anchor: وقيل المراد باليسرى الطريقة التي هي أيسر وأسهل في حفظ الوحي

ALUSI:87:8/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r5.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:8/r5.claim: Another alternative identifies al-yusrā as the easy, upright religious law.

ALUSI:87:8/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r6.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:87:8/r6.claim: A further view reads al-yusrā as good worldly and afterlife outcomes, such as victory, high standing, and elevation in Paradise; adding religious affairs makes this broad.
ALUSI:87:8/r6.anchor: وقيل الأمور الحسنة في أمر الدنيا والآخرة من النصر وعلو المنزلة والرفعة

ALUSI:87:8/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:87:8/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI:87:8/r7.claim: The next verse's fāʾ is especially apt if the promise includes religious affairs and readiness to remind others.
ALUSI:87:8/r7.anchor: قوله تعالى : فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَى

BAGHAWI:87:8/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:8/r1.speaker: مقاتل وابن عباس
BAGHAWI:87:8/r1.claim: Mقاتil says God makes the Prophet's work of the people of Paradise easy, which is Ibn Abbas's meaning, and enables him to do good.
BAGHAWI:87:8/r1.anchor: قال مقاتل : نهون عليك عمل أهل الجنة -وهو معنى قول ابن عباس- ونيسرك لأن تعمل خيراً .

BAGHAWI:87:8/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:8/r2.anchor: ونيسرك لأن تعمل خيراً . واليسرى : عمل الخير .

BAGHAWI:87:8/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:8/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:8/r3.claim: An alternative explanation is that God grants the Prophet success in the easy, tolerant monotheistic law.
BAGHAWI:87:8/r3.anchor: وقيل : نوفقك للشريعة اليسرى وهي الحنيفية السمحة .

BAGHAWI:87:8/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:87:8/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:87:8/r4.claim: Another view connects this promise to the preceding verse: God knows the Prophet's audible recitation to Gabriel and his private rehearsal from fear of forgetting, then eases revelation so he can retain and teach it.
BAGHAWI:87:8/r4.anchor: وقيل : هو متصل بالكلام الأول معناه : أنه يعلم الجهر مما تقرؤه على جبريل إذا فرغ من التلاوة

BAYDAWI:87:8/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:87:8/r1.claim: God will prepare the Prophet for the easier path, whether preserving revelation or religious practice, and enable him to follow it.
BAYDAWI:87:8/r1.anchor: ونعدك لطريقة اليسرى في حفظ الوحي أو التدين وتوفقك لها

BAYDAWI:87:8/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:87:8/r2.claim: The wording says God makes the Prophet easy for the path, rather than making the path easy for him; it coordinates with “We shall recite to you.”
BAYDAWI:87:8/r2.anchor: ولهذه النكتة قال نيسرك لا نيسر لك عطف على سنقرئك

BAYDAWI:87:8/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:87:8/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:87:8/r3.claim: The statement that God knows is parenthetical.

BIQAI:87:8/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:8/r1.claim: After discussing divinity, prophethood, and abrogation, Biqāʿī presents the revealed religion as tolerant and easy; what God establishes is easiest and most fitting for its time.
BIQAI:87:8/r1.anchor: ولما ذكر الإلهيات والنبوة وأشير إلى النسخ ، أشار إلى أن الدين المشروع له هو الحنيفية السمحة ، وأنه سبحانه وتعالى لا يقيمه في شيء بنسخ أو غيره إلا كان هو الأيسر له

BIQAI:87:8/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:8/r2.claim: God makes the Prophet prepared, facilitated, gentle, and successful in the easy way, including preserving and contemplating revelation and every light, gentle course.

BIQAI:87:8/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:8/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:8/r3.claim: The wording makes the Prophet himself easy and predisposed to love ease, rather than merely saying that God makes ease available for him.
BIQAI:87:8/r3.anchor: ولهذا لم يقل : ونيسر لك ، لأنه هو مطبوع على حبها

BIQAI:87:8/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:87:8/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:87:8/r4.claim: Biqāʿī cites the saying that everyone is facilitated toward what they were created for as support for this divinely fitted ease.

DURR:87:8/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:87:8/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:87:8/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses al-yusrā as goodness.
DURR:87:8/r1.anchor: وأخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن ابن عباس في قوله : { ونيسرك لليسرى } قال : للخير .

IBNASHUR:87:8/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r1.claim: The clause is joined to the promise in verse 6, while verse 7 is parenthetical; the new promise broadens the result from preservation to enabling good.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r1.anchor: عطف على { سنقرئك فلا تنسى } [ الأعلى :  6 ]

IBNASHUR:87:8/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r2.claim: Taysīr means making an action easy for the person who performs it.

IBNASHUR:87:8/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r3.claim: The object of making easy is the thing facilitated; the beneficiary or purpose is expressed with a following lām, as in Moses’ prayer.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r3.anchor: ومفعول فعل التيسير هو الشيء الذي يُجعل يسيراً

IBNASHUR:87:8/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r4.claim: Al-yusrā is the feminine of al-aysar; the fuʿlā form intensifies the quality because it is the feminine of an elative.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r4.anchor: مؤنث الأيسر ،  وصيغة فُعلى تدل على قوة الوصف

IBNASHUR:87:8/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r5.claim: The described noun is omitted; its feminine adjective implies a feminine singular noun or a plural treated grammatically as feminine.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r5.anchor: تأنيث الوصف مشعر بأن الموصوف المحذوف مما يجري

IBNASHUR:87:8/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r6.claim: The context points to the omitted noun being the religious law: the Messenger’s defining first responsibility is the law he was sent to deliver.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r6.anchor: وسياق الكلام الذي قبله يهدي إلى أن يكون الموصوف المقدر معنى الشريعة فإن خطاب الرسول

IBNASHUR:87:8/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r7.claim: On the surface reading followed by the commentators, making the Prophet easy for the way means preparing and empowering him for easier religious duties and their good outcomes.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r7.anchor: إن حمل على ظاهر نظم الكلام وهو ما جرى عليه المفسرون

IBNASHUR:87:8/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r8.claim: God prepares the Prophet for ease in religion, including preserving the Quran, carrying the revealed law, and receiving worldly and afterlife good.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r8.anchor: أي نهيئك للأمور اليسرى في أمر الدين وعواقبه من تيسير حفظ القرآن لك وتيسير الشريعة

IBNASHUR:87:8/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r9.claim: The lām gives a purpose or end: God enables the Prophet for the way of ease and its acceptance.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r9.anchor: العلةُ ،  أي لأجل اليسرى ،  أي لقبولها

IBNASHUR:87:8/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r10.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR:87:8/r10.claim: The Prophet’s saying that everyone is enabled for what they were created for illustrates this sense and parallels the two outcomes in al-Layl.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r10.anchor: ونحوه قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNASHUR:87:8/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r11.claim: Alternatively, the wording may use rhetorical inversion for “We make the easy way easy for you,” leaving the verb’s ordinary sense intact.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r11.anchor: ويجوز أن يجعل الكلام جاريا على خلاف مقتضى الظاهر بسلوك أسلوب القلب

IBNASHUR:87:8/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r12.claim: Calling the way “easy” suggests its ease is already established; God need only protect the Prophet from obstacles to receiving it.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r12.anchor: إيماء إلى استتباب تيسره لها بما أنها جُعلت يسرى

IBNASHUR:87:8/r13.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r13.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r13.claim: The promise includes two forms of facilitation: making the Prophet’s charge easy while fulfilling its purpose, and enabling the Prophet to carry it out.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r13.anchor: تيسير ما كلف به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أي جعله يسيراً مع وفائه بالمقصود منه

IBNASHUR:87:8/r14.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r14.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r14.claim: The inversion emphatically identifies the facilitated person with the facilitated way; Ibn ʿĀshūr cites the Arabic expression about presenting a camel to a trough, al-ʿAjjāj’s verse, and the Quranic image in al-Qaṣaṣ.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r14.anchor: بأن فيه تنزيل الشيء الميسر منزلة الشيء الميسر له والعكس للمبالغة في ثبوت الفعل للمفعول

IBNASHUR:87:8/r15.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r15.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:87:8/r15.claim: The verse reassures the initially anxious Messenger that God equips him to bear the burdens of revelation and the demanding work of guiding the community.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r15.anchor: وعد الله إياه بأنه يسره لتلقي أعباء الرسالة فلا تشق عليه ولا تحرجه

IBNASHUR:87:8/r16.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:87:8/r16.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR:87:8/r16.claim: The Prophet’s preference for the easier of two options and his instruction that his companions were sent to facilitate, not make things difficult, exemplify this promise.
IBNASHUR:87:8/r16.anchor: ومن آثار هذا التيسير ما ورد في الحديث

IBNATIYYA:87:8/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:87:8/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:87:8/r1.claim: God leads the Prophet toward what is commendable in this life and the next: victory, success, the high standing of his message, and elevation in Paradise.
IBNATIYYA:87:8/r1.anchor: معناه : نذهب بك نحو الأمور المستحسنة في دنياك وأخراك من النصر والظفر وعلو الرسالة والمنزلة يوم القيامة ، والرفعة في الجنة

IBNKATHIR:87:8/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:87:8/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:87:8/r1.claim: God makes good deeds and words easy for Muhammad and prescribes a lenient, straight, just law without deviation, hardship, or distress.
IBNKATHIR:87:8/r1.anchor: نسهل عليك أفعال الخير وأقواله ، ونشرع لك شرعا سهلا سمحا مستقيما عدلا لا اعوجاج فيه ولا حرج ولا عسر

KASHSHAF:87:8/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:8/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:8/r1.claim: The clause is coordinated with “We shall make you recite”; “He knows what is spoken aloud and hidden” is parenthetical.
KASHSHAF:87:8/r1.anchor: معطوف على { سَنُقْرِئُكَ } وقوله : { إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الجهر وَمَا يخفى } اعتراض

KASHSHAF:87:8/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:8/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:87:8/r2.claim: God will enable the Prophet along the easiest path, glossed here as retaining the revelation.
KASHSHAF:87:8/r2.anchor: ومعناه : ونوفقك للطريقة التي هي أيسر وأسهل ، يعني : حفظ الوحي .

KASHSHAF:87:8/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:8/r3.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF:87:8/r3.claim: An alternative takes the easy path as the tolerant, easiest-to-follow revealed law.
KASHSHAF:87:8/r3.anchor: وقيل للشريعة السمحة التي هي أيسر الشرائع وأسهلها مأخذاً

KASHSHAF:87:8/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:87:8/r4.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF:87:8/r4.claim: Another interpretation is that God enables the Prophet to perform the deeds of Paradise.

MAWARDI:87:8/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:87:8/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI:87:8/r1.claim: God will make the Prophet able to do good.
MAWARDI:87:8/r1.anchor: أحدها : نيسرك لأن تعمل خيرا ، قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI:87:8/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:87:8/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI:87:8/r2.claim: God will make the Prophet’s way lead to Paradise.

MAWARDI:87:8/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:87:8/r3.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI:87:8/r3.claim: God will make the Prophet’s way the religion and ease, not hardship.
MAWARDI:87:8/r3.anchor: الثالث : للدين واليسر وليس بالعسر ، قاله الضحاك

NASAFI:87:8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:87:8/r1.claim: “We will ease you” is coordinated with “We will make you recite,” while the statement about God's knowledge is parenthetical.
NASAFI:87:8/r1.anchor: معطوف على { سَنُقْرِئُكَ } وقوله { إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الجهر وَمَا يخفى } اعتراض

NASAFI:87:8/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:87:8/r2.claim: God will guide the Prophet to the easier way, meaning preservation of revelation.
NASAFI:87:8/r2.anchor: ونوفقك للطريقة التي هي أيسر وأسهل يعني حفظ الوحي

NASAFI:87:8/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:8/r3.speaker: قيل
NASAFI:87:8/r3.claim: Another explanation is that God guides him to the tolerant, easy religious law.
NASAFI:87:8/r3.anchor: وقيل : للشريعة السمحة التي هي أيسر الشرائع

NASAFI:87:8/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:87:8/r4.speaker: قيل
NASAFI:87:8/r4.claim: A further explanation is that God guides him to the deeds of Paradise.
NASAFI:87:8/r4.anchor: أو نوفقك لعمل الجنة { فَذَكِّرْ } عظ

QURTUBI:87:8/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:87:8/r1.claim: Wa-nuyassiruka coordinates with sa-nuqriʾuka, while the statement that God knows the manifest and hidden is parenthetical.
QURTUBI:87:8/r1.anchor: معطوف على " سنقرئك " وقوله : " إنه يعلم الجهر

QURTUBI:87:8/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI:87:8/r2.claim: Al-yusrā is the easier way, namely doing good works.
QURTUBI:87:8/r2.anchor: ومعنى " لليسرى " أي للطريقة اليسرى ، وهي عمل الخير

QURTUBI:87:8/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:87:8/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses the promise as enabling the Prophet to do good.
QURTUBI:87:8/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس : نيسرك لأن تعمل خيرا

QURTUBI:87:8/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
QURTUBI:87:8/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd identifies al-yusrā as Paradise.

QURTUBI:87:8/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r5.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI:87:8/r5.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says God guides the Prophet to the easy, tolerant Ḥanīfī law.
QURTUBI:87:8/r5.anchor: وقيل : نوفقك للشريعة اليسرى ، وهي الحنيفية السمحة السهلة . قال معناه الضحاك

QURTUBI:87:8/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:87:8/r6.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI:87:8/r6.claim: Another interpretation is that God makes revelation easy for the Prophet to memorize and act upon.
QURTUBI:87:8/r6.anchor: وقيل : أي نهون عليك الوحي حتى تحفظه وتعمل به

RAZI:87:8/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r1.claim: Al-yusrā means good works that lead to ease.
RAZI:87:8/r1.anchor: اليسرى هي أعمال الخير التي تؤدي إلى اليسر

RAZI:87:8/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r2.claim: The preferred syntax coordinates this clause with 87:6 and treats 87:7 as an interjection; it means God will guide the Prophet to the easiest way of preserving the Qurʾān.

RAZI:87:8/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
RAZI:87:8/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿūd says al-yusrā is Paradise, so God makes the Prophet able to do the deeds that lead to it.

RAZI:87:8/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r4.speaker: بعض المفسرين
RAZI:87:8/r4.claim: Another interpretation is that God makes revelation easy for the Prophet to memorize, learn, and practice.
RAZI:87:8/r4.anchor: نهون عليك الوحي حتى تحفظه وتعلمه وتعمل به

RAZI:87:8/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r5.speaker: بعض المفسرين
RAZI:87:8/r5.claim: Another interpretation is that God guides him to the easy, tolerant ḥanīfī law.
RAZI:87:8/r5.anchor: نوفقك للشريعة وهي الحنيفية السهلة السمحة

RAZI:87:8/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r6.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r6.claim: The Qurʾān and the Prophet say that the agent is made ready for an act, rather than the act being made easy for the agent; this wording also occurs in Sūrat al-Layl and the Prophetic saying.
RAZI:87:8/r6.anchor: هذه العبارة كما أنها اختيار القرآن في هذا الموضع ، وفي سورة الليل

RAZI:87:8/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r7.speaker: محمد
RAZI:87:8/r7.claim: The Prophet said, “Act; each person is facilitated for what he was created for.”
RAZI:87:8/r7.anchor: اختيار الرسول في قوله عليه السلام : «اعملوا فكل ميسر لما خلق له »

RAZI:87:8/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r8.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r8.claim: An act is possible while existence and nonexistence remain equal; it occurs only when the active side is preferred, and that preference is facilitation, so the agent is made ready for the act.
RAZI:87:8/r8.anchor: فإذا نرجح جانب الفاعلية على جانب التاركية ، فحينئذ يحصل الفعل

RAZI:87:8/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r9.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r9.claim: The majestic plural underscores the greatness of the gift through the greatness of its giver, as in other divine first-person plurals.
RAZI:87:8/r9.anchor: إنما قال : { ونيسرك لليسرى } بنون التعظيم لتكون عظمة المعطى دالة على عظمة العطاء

RAZI:87:8/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:87:8/r10.speaker: author
RAZI:87:8/r10.claim: God opened a degree of ease for the Prophet unequalled for anyone else, making an orphan raised among an ignorant people a model and guide for all humanity.
RAZI:87:8/r10.anchor: فتح عليه من أبواب التيسير والتسهيل ما لم يفتحه على أحد غيره

DURR:87:6/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:87:6/r6.speaker: قتادة
DURR:87:6/r6.claim: Qatāda says the Prophet forgot nothing except what God willed; public and hidden knowledge includes inner whispering.
DURR:87:6/r6.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : { سنقرئك فلا تنسى إلا ما شاء الله } قال : كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لا ينسى شيئا إلا ما شاء الله

DURR:87:6/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:87:6/r7.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
DURR:87:6/r7.claim: Saʿīd b. Jubayr glosses what God knows as what a person conceals within himself.
DURR:87:6/r7.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير { إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى } قال : ما أخفيت في نفسك .

QASHANI:87:6-10/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:87:6-10/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:87:6-10/r4.claim: The easy way is the tolerant, easy sacred law, the easiest road to God; the clause continues the promise of recitation.
QASHANI:87:6-10/r4.anchor: الشريعة السمحة السهلة التي هي أيسر الطرق إلى الله

QASHANI:87:6-10/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:87:6-10/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:87:6-10/r5.claim: God completes the Prophet with full and superabundant intellectual and practical perfection, wisdom, and power.
QASHANI:87:6-10/r5.anchor: نكملك بالكمال العلمي والعملي التام وفوق التام الذي هو التكميل

NAHHAS:v5p205/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p205/r12.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p205/r12.claim: The phrase means the present state or condition of ease.

ASAD-NOTES:87:6/r4.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:87:6/r4.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:87:6/r4.claim: God will make the path toward ultimate ease easy for the Prophet.
ASAD-NOTES:87:6/r4.anchor: shall We make easy for thee the path towards [ultimate] ease

CORPUSCORANICUM:87:1-8:kommentar/r8.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:1-8:kommentar/r8.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:1-8:kommentar/r8.claim: The promise of ease in verse 8 recalls the earlier consolatory surah 94.
CORPUSCORANICUM:87:1-8:kommentar/r8.anchor: in terminologischer Anknüpfung an die frühere Trostsure 94

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r1.claim: The preceding sūrah urges the Prophet to wait: persistent deniers receive only temporary respite under God's practice, and cannot escape His grasp.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r1.anchor: Sūrah al-Ṭāriq, the previous sūrah ended on urging the Prophet (sws) to show patience and to wait for the decision of God.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r2.claim: This sūrah shifts its primary address from stubborn Quraysh to the Prophet and, over at least ten following sūrahs, dispels his preaching fears in varied ways.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r2.anchor: while ignoring these stubborn elements from among the Quraysh, the Prophet (sws) is addressed directly and given glad tidings

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r4.claim: Verses 6–8 promise that revelation will mature for the Prophet, remain preserved except for what God wills to set aside, and bring ease from known hardships.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p270/r4.anchor: The favour of revelations that he is receiving will gradually reach its culmination

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r2.claim: The verse gives the Prophet clear glad tidings that present hardships will end and God will lead him toward ease.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r2.anchor: the hardships he is currently facing will one day end and the Almighty will lead him towards ease

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r3.claim: The term rendered ease is described grammatically as an adjective modifying an implicit noun.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r3.anchor: is an adjective of a suppressed noun similar in meaning to

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p278/r4.claim: The Prophet's hardships train and discipline him for future divine favor; this follows the law of gradual development, and ease comes after difficulty.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r3.claim: The clause about making the Prophet's way easy is coordinated with the recitation promise; the intervening assurance is parenthetical, and ease first means retaining revelation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r3.anchor: ونيسرك معطوف على سنقرئك، وما بينهما من الجملة المؤكدة اعتراض

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r4.claim: Other interpretations make the easy way the lenient Ḥanīfī law or good worldly and afterlife outcomes, including victory, high rank, and Paradise.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p457/r4.anchor: وقيل: للشريعة الحنيفية السهلة. وقيل: يذهب بك إلى الأمور الحسنة

DURR-FULL:v8p483/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r6.claim: The easy way to which God makes the Prophet ready is goodness.
DURR-FULL:v8p483/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {ونيسرك لليسرى} قال: للخير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p272/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p272/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p272/r3.claim: The surah supports and steadies the Prophet in receiving revelation and promises him a gracious law and a book that reminds the purified and God-fearing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p272/r3.anchor: شريعة سمحة وكتابا يتذكر به أهل النفوس الزكية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p277/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p277/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p277/r3.claim: Proportioning and guidance suit the surah because God who fashioned the Prophet for the burdens of mission also equips him to retain revelation and grants him an easy law.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p277/r3.anchor: الذي يسوي خلق النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم تسوية تلائم ما خلقه لأجله من تحمل أعباء الرسالة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r5.claim: The ease promised to the Prophet broadens the preceding promise of preservation: it means making good easy for him, not simply protecting revelation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r5.anchor: مفهومها الحفظ والصيانة ومفهوم المعطوفة تيسير الخير له

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r6.claim: Taysir means making a task easy for its doer, with the benefited person commonly expressed by a following phrase with li-.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r6.anchor: والتيسير : جعل العمل يسيرا على عامله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r7.claim: Al-yusra is the feminine of al-aysar, and the faʿla pattern intensifies the quality.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p281/r7.anchor: واليسرى : مؤنث الأيسر ، وصيغة فعلى تدل على قوة الوصف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p469/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p469/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p469/r10.claim: God directs the Prophet toward good things in this life and the next: victory, success, the elevation of his message, and high rank in Paradise.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p469/r10.anchor: ونيسرك لليسرى معناه: نذهب بك نحو الأمور المستحسنة في دنياك وأخراك من النصر والظفر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p379#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p379#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p379#2/r5.claim: God makes good words and deeds easy for Muhammad and prescribes a straight, tolerant law without hardship.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p379#2/r5.anchor: أي: نسهل عليك أفعال الخير وأقواله، ونشرع لك شرعا سهلا سمحا مستقيما عدلا لا اعوجاج فيه

JISHUMI:v10p7373/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7373/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7373/r4.claim: Al-yusrā is ease in doing good; facilitation can come through ability or preparation, and yasar may be named by optimism or because work with the right hand is easy.
JISHUMI:v10p7373/r4.anchor: واليسرى: الفعلى من اليسر، وهو سهولة عمل الخير، والتيسير: التسهيل، وقد يكون بالتمكين

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets facilitation as making good works possible.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r10.anchor: نيسرك لأن تعمل خيرا , قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r11.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r11.claim: Ibn Masud interprets the easiest way as Paradise.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r12.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r12.claim: Al-Dahhak says it means the easy religion, not the difficult one.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p253/r12.anchor: للدين واليسر وليس بالعسر , قاله الضحاك .

TABATABAI:87:1-19#3/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:1-19#3/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:1-19#3/r6.claim: Al-yusrā means an omitted ‘easy way’; God prepares the Prophet to choose the easiest path of preaching and bear its difficulties.

TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r1.claim: The wording prepares the Prophet himself for the easy way rather than making the way easy for him; this recalls Moses' pledge to speak truth about God.
TABATABAI:87:1-19#4/r1.anchor: وإنما عدل عن ذلك إلى قوله { ونيسرك لليسرى } لأن الكلام في تجهيزه

THALABI:v10p184/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p184/r6.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p184/r6.claim: One view takes ease toward ease as ease in the work of Paradise; another as easy revelation to memorize, teach, and practice; a third as tolerant law.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r7.speaker: Müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r7.claim: Exegetes apply the promise of ease specifically to the Prophet and describe it as God enabling him without human effort to memorize the Qur’an, observe religious rules, and perform deeds leading to Paradise; Zamakhshari and Razi are cited.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r7.anchor: Müfessirler, “Sana kolaylık ve huzurun yollarını açacağız” meâlindeki 8. âyeti de Hz. Peygamber’in şahsına özgü olarak

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r8.speaker: Şevkânî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r8.claim: Shawkani interprets the ease as God granting success in whichever religious or worldly matter the Prophet undertakes.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:87:6/r8.anchor: Şevkânî ise “din ve dünya işlerinden hangisine yönelirse o yolda muvaffak kılması” anlamında yorumlamıştır
